tei:div.tei:p: byang chub sems dpa'i lam rim skabs lnga pa bzhugs so/ (158)'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// kun mkhyen mi yi seng ge don kun grub// rgyal ba'i sras mchog mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs// chos kyi shing rta klu thogs mar me mdzad// 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa rnams la 'dud// rnam dpyod yangs pas shes bya'i gnas lugs rtogs// snying rje chen pos 'gro kun rjes su 'dzin// mthu stobs nus pas 'brel tshad byang chub bkod// kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud// tshe rabs kun tu yang dag dam pa'i chos// mi 'bral 'dzin dang blo la goms pa'i phyir// mi brjed gzungs su dran thor dgod pa la// lha dang bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun kyi gnad bsdus pa// shing rta chen po klu thogs gnyis kyi srol// skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa ni/ (159)/slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ras mdzad// rgyal bas legs par bshad pa ji snyed pa// gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam yin pas// lam gyi gtso dang lam gyi yan lag tu// ci rigs par 'gyur byang chub sems dpa' yi// bzhed don 'jig rten bsgrub pa nyid yin pas// gdul bya rigs can gsum ka rjes su 'dzin// dgos pas de dag lam la bslab dgos so// rang gi ma nges gzhan la bstan mi nus// theg chen 'jug pa'i lam la thun mong ba// theg dman sde snod yin pas dor mi rung*// rang don zhi bde la sogs dmigs bsal can// 'ga' re ma gtogs thams cad nyams len dgos// rdzogs sangs rgyas ni skyon zad yon tan rdzogs// phyogs re ma yin mtha' dag bsgrub dgos pas// theg gzhan spangs rtogs theg chen lam du 'du// sngags la zhugs na'ang theg (160)chen sde snod kyi// sems bskyed pa dang phyin drug slob pa rnams// rnam pa thams cad du ni brten dgos par// sngags kyi gzhung las yang yang gsungs pa'i phyir// gnang bkag mi 'dra thun thun mthong nas kyang*// tsha grang bzhin du 'gal bar 'dzin pa ni// rtogs pa shin tu rtsing ba yin par gsal// de bas dmigs bsal can gyi gnang bkag ni// 'ga' re ma gtogs gsung rab thams cad mthun// gong mar 'jug tshe 'og mar gzhir bzhag dgos// pha rol phyin pa mdo sngags thun mong lam// de steng sngags lam dbang dang dam tshig dang*// rim gnyis 'khor bcas bsnan pas sangs rgyas su// bgrod pa myur gyi dor na nor ba che// de ltar ma yin chos spong las su 'gyur// de bas mdo sngags gnad rnams gang zag gcig

/'tshang rgya'i lam du bsdus nas khrid pas na// bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa yin// thar 'dod rnams kyi 'phral yun phan bde'i gzhi// blang dor gnas ston 'khrul pa bral ba ni// sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin phyir de bas na// gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag 'char ba yin// dgongs 'grel dam pa'i man ngag mi ldan par// rang stobs zhugs pas (161)dgongs pa mi rnyed pas// shing rta chen po rnams kyi dgongs 'grel la// brten na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed// de ltar nges pas chos spong bzlog 'gyur bas// nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags 'gro ba'o// nyan pa'i tshul la snod kyi skyon gsum spongs// rang la nad pa chos smra sman pa dang*// chos la sman dang nyams len nad 'tsho ba// de bzhin gshegs la skyes bu dam pa dang*// chos tshul ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes drug bshad pa'i tshul yang 'khor la byams pa dang*// phrag dog le lo skyo bas gzhan skyon gleng*// dpe 'khyud byed dang zang zing blta ba spongs// bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags bton bzhin gsal bas// dpe dang gtan tshigs lung dang ldan par bshad// mjug tu bsngo bas rgyas btab 'chad nyan gyi// phan yon mtha' yas gnad du ma song ba'i// las sgrib sngar bsags dag cing gsar mi bsog /gnad du song bas gdam pas phan thogs par// gzigs nas dam pa rnams kyis 'chad nyan mdzod// gdams pa dngos kyi slob ma khrid tshul la// lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen mtshan nyid kyang*// tshul khrims bslab pas sems kyi rta dul ba// ting nge (162)'dzin gyi bslab pas zhi ba dang*// shes rab bslab pas nye bar zhi ba'o// mang du thos pa'i lung gis phyug pa dang*// chos bdag med dang de nyid mngon du gyur// slob ma las kyang yon tan lhag par bcas// de drug rang gi thob pa'i yon tan no// lhag ma gzhan rjes 'dzin pa'i yon tan ni// ji ltar bkri ba'i rim pa smra mkhas ldan// kun slong dag pas chos ston brtse ba che// gzhan gyi don la spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang*// chad pa'i dka' spyad bzod pas skyo ba spang*// de dag shes pas mtshan nyid ldan pa tshol// gzur gnas phyogs lhung med dang blo ldan ni// legs bshad nyes bshad rnam par 'byed pa dang*// don gnyer ldan pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid yin// bla ma bsten tshul sdong po bkod pa las// rang dbang dor nas bla ma'i dbang du gtong*// sdig grogs sogs kyi mi phyed rdo rje bzhin// khur gyis yongs su mi skyo sa lta bu// khor yug ri ltar sdug bsngal thams cad kyi// mi bsgul ba dang 'jig rten bran lta bur// ngan las nyams su myang yang yid mi 'phrig

/phyag dar lta bu'i sems ni nga rgyal spang*// theg pa lta bu bya dka' spro bzhin 'dzin// khyi ltar bla mas brnyas kyang der mi khro// (163)gru ltar 'gro 'ong gnas la skyo ba spang*// bla mar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhin blta// ngan song las skyob mnyam pa nyid rtogs byed// lam ni bde dang mi bde ston pa dang*// kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa 'dam pa'o// thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer lam ston pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas su skyel ba'o// chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa dang*// dus gsum shes bya'i rgya mtshor ston pa'o// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ston pa dang*// dkar po'i chos rnams 'phel bar byed pa'o// yun ring 'khor bar 'khyams pa tshol ba dang*// gti mug bsgribs shing gnyid log sad par byed// srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying ba 'byin pa dang*// lam ngan zhugs la lam bzang ston par byed// srid pa'i brtson rar bcings pa 'grol ba dang*// yun ring nad kyis nyams thag sman pa dang*// 'dod chags la sogs me rab 'bar ba ni// zhi bar byed pa'i char sprin lta bu dang*// chos kun yon tan yongs su ston byed de// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod lam yongs ston pa// 'di dag bskyed pas bdag gi ma lta bu// yon tan 'o ma ldud pas ma ma 'dra// byang chub yan lag yongs su sbyong ba yin// dge bshes 'di dag gnod pa rnam par bzlog / (164)sga shi thar byed sman pa lta bu ste// bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs lha dbang brgya byin 'dra// zla nya lta bu dkar po'i chos kyis rgyas// zhi ba'i phyogs ston nyi ma gsal ba 'dra// dgra dang grogs la ri bo 'dra ba ste// rgya mtsho bzhin du mi 'khrugs sems dang ldan// yongs su skyong pa mnyan pa 'dra ba dang*// 'jig rten skyong bas dpa' bo lta bu ste// ded dpon mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa yin// 'di dag bdag la bde stob mig yin zhes// de 'dra'i sems kyis dge bshes bsnyen bkur byed// ngag tu brjod cing yid la rtse gcig dran// bla ma mnyes byed sgrub la mi mnyes spangs// bkur sti rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang*// sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya// chos ma yin pa smra na bzlog par bya// nye ring ran par yun ring bsrings nas bsten// bla ma bsten pas yon tan tshogs rnams rdzogs// dam pa rnams ni sus kyang mi bsring te// dul ba'i tshul gyis dge ba bstan par bya// de dang nye na de yi yon tan rdul// ched du ma bsgos par yang 'gos par 'gyur// de bas bla ma bstain pa'i tshul rnams la// thun gyi dngos gzhi dpyad 'jog spel ma bya// thun mtshams dmigs rnam dran shes brten pa dang*// dbang shes la brten yid shes chags sdang la// dran pa bsrung dang dran (165)la rtag 'grus byed// nyon mongs can las dbang po'i sgo sdom mo// bya dang bya min shes las 'jug ldog la// gzob par byed pa'i shes bzhin 'jog pa'o// zas kyi tshod rig zas la zhen mi bya// nyin dang mtshan gyi cha gsum bar bar nyal// dal ba'i rten la snying po len par bskul// gang tshe rang dbang 'jug cing mthun gnas la// gal te 'di bdag 'dzin par mi byed na// g.yang sar lhung bas gzhan dbang 'jug gyur pa// de nas phyi nas gang gis slong bar 'gyur// bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras mi yi lus// 'thob par mi 'gyur de tshe dge ba med// tshul khrims gzhi bzung sbyin sogs grogs byas nas// smon lam mtshams sbyor dgos na rgyu dang ni// ngan 'gro la ltos bde 'gro'ang srid mtha' tsam// 'bras bu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba yin// snying po len tshul dngos la skyes bu gsum// lam gyi rim pa'i dang po 'jig rten gyi// phyi ma'i don du 'chi ba dran pa'i blo// med na tshe 'di tsam gyis ched du 'gro// yod na phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sgo// nges par 'chi ba 'chi bdag 'ong ba la// rkyen gyis bzlog med yul gang bsdad kyang 'chi// dus kun sems can 'chi ba 'joms pa la//

(166)khyad par med la bros pas mi thar zhing*// sngags sogs bzlog med tshe la bsnon pa med// 'brid byed bar ma chad pa yod pa dang*// dpe la bsam yang mi rtag mi ston med// gson pa'i tshe yang long med nges par 'chi// 'chi rkyen shin tu mang zhing gson rkyen nyung*// lus nyams chung bas nam 'chi nges pa med// 'chi tshe bshes dang nor dang sha rus dag so sor 'byes pas tshe 'di'i phun tshogs kyis// bdag 'dor bdag gis 'di dag dor ba'i dus// chos ma gtogs pa gang gis kyang mi phan// shi nas med du mi 'gro 'khor bar 'khor// ngan 'gror skyes na dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni// yang sos thig nag bdud 'joms ngu 'bod dang*// ngu 'bod chen po tsha ba rab tsha ba// mnar med pa dang me ma mur gyi 'obs// phyi sa'i 'dam ni ro ltar gnas pa dang*// spu gri'i lam dang ral gri'i nags tshal dang*// lcags kyi shal ma li yi tshal rnams dang*// chu klung rab med 'bar dang tho lum dang*// zangs zhun bskol ba khar blugs nye 'khor bzhi// grang dmyal chu bur chu bur rdol ba dang*// so thams kyi hud a chu zer ba dang*// utpal padma pad chen ltar gas brgyad// gnas tha dad par sa yi dngos gzhir gsungs// nyi tshe'i dmyal ba tsha grang (167)nye 'khor dang*// mi yi yul dang mtsho chen 'gram na yod// skye ba'i rgyu ni sgo gsum nyes spyod yin// dud 'grau gcig la gcig za bkol spyod kyis// rtag tu mnar zhing yi dwags phyi sgrib can// zas skom bsrung dang nang sgrib gsus che sogs// me lce'i phreng can zos pas me 'bar 'tshig /ljan ljin bshang gci rang sha za sogs yod// ngan 'gror 'jigs pa skyobs nus dkon mchog nyid// rang nyid 'jigs pa las grol gzhan 'jigs las// grol ba'i thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po yis// nye ring phan btags ma btags thams cad kyi// don mdzad skyabs su 'os pa sangs rgyas yin// des bstan chos dang dge 'dun skyabs su 'os// sangs rgyas sku yi yon tan mtshan dpe dang*// gsungs gcig gdul bya rang rang skad du ston// mkhyen rtse nus pa thugs kyi yon tan dang*// lhun gyi grub dang rgyun mi 'chad pa yi// phrin las yon tan sangs rgyas rjes dran tshul// rgyas par gsung rab dgongs 'grel dag las snang*// chos ni lung rtogs 'gog dang lam gyi bden// skyon spangs yon tan sgrub pa'i bdag nyid can// mngon du byas dang bsgom pa las byung ngo*// de tshul bsgrub pa dge 'dun (168)yon tan no// de la ston pa lam dang grogs kyi tshul// bslab bya bsdu ba las byung bzhi tshan gnyis// skyes bu dam pa bsten dang rjes mthun bsgrub// chos nyan yid byed chos dang rjes mthun bsgrub// dbang po mi rgod bslab gzhi yang dag blang*// snying rje dus su dkon mchog mchod la brtson// myang 'das las byung lha gzhan skyabs mi 'gro// sems can gnod spang mu stegs can mi 'grogs// dgag pa'i gsum yin so sor gus pas bsgrub// thun mong dkon mchog gsum gyi khyad par dang*// yon tan rjes dran yang yang skyabs su 'gro// dus mchod brtson cing bza' bca'i thad kyi mchod// snying rjes 'gro gzhan skyabs 'gro 'di la 'god// dgos pa che yang 'jig rten thabs gzhan spang*// phan yon shes nas nyin mtshan skyabs 'gror bya// phan yon bsdu bar bsod nams rgya chen thob// dga' ba mchog dga' ting 'dzin shes rab thob// bsrung ba che ldan sgrib pa thams cad zad// skyes bu dam par lha rnams yid du 'ong*// gzhan yang nang pa sangs rgyas sar chud cing*// sdom pa'i rten gyur sngon bsags las sgrib 'dzad// bsod nams rgya chen mi dang mi min gyi// bar gcod mi tshugs ci bsam (169)thams cad 'grub// myur du 'tshang rgya la sogs phan yon ldan// dkon mchog bzhad gad phyir ram srog gi phyir// mi btang bsrung bar bya ba rnam pa drug

/'bras bu ngan 'gro las skyob rgyu dus na// yid ni mi dge ba la 'jug pa bcos// bde legs thams cad rtsa ba yid ches kyi// dad pa bskyed la las 'bras bsam pa ni// mi dge ba las ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dang*// dge las bde 'gro'i bde ba thams cad 'byung*// rgyu med pa dang gtso bo dbang phyug sogs// mi mthun rgyu las byung min las 'bras ni// mi bslu nges pa rnyed pa yang dag lta// dge sdig chung ngus 'bras bu rgya cher 'phel// tshul khrims 'tsho ba sogs nyams klu ru skye// las ni ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad cing*// byas pa chud mi za bar rgyal bas gsungs// mi dge bcu ni gzhi bsam sbyor mthar thug /srog gcod tshig rtsub gnod sems dug gsum gyis// rtsom la zhe sdang mthar 'byin ma byin len// log g.yem brnab sems dug gsum rtsom par byed// 'dod chags mthar 'byin rdzun phra kyal ba ni// rtsom pa mthar phyin gnyis ka gsum char byed// log lta dug gsum rtsom la gti mug gis// mthar thug lus ngag bdun ni las kyang (170)yin// sems la 'jug pa'i gzhi yin las lam min// brnab sems sogs gsum las min las kyi lam// rtag dang mngon zhen gnyen po med pa dang*// yon tan zhing dang phan 'dogs gzhi las byung*// dge dang mi dge gnyis ka chen po yin// rnam smin 'bras bu ngan 'gro gsum por ltung*// rgyu mthun 'bras bu mir skyes rim pa ltar// tshe thung nor dbul chung ma mi bsrung ba// bskur mang mdza' bo 'byed dang mi snyan thos// bsgo ba mi nyan dug gsum shas che'o// bdag goms dbang gis 'bras bu yul la smin// 'chi bar 'gyur dang 'bras bu med pa dang*// nyams mi dga' dang bslu bas 'jigs pa dang*// 'grod dka' ba dang shin tu rtsub pa dang*// dus su 'bras med phun tshogs 'grib pa dang*// gnod pa mang shing skyobs pa med par 'gyur// dkar po'i las kyis rnam smin 'bras bu spang*// mi dang 'dod lha gong ma'i lhar skye'o// rgyu mthun bdag 'bras gang las bzlog ste sbyar// bde 'gror 'phen byed las ni dge ba dang*// ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i las ni mi dge ba// rdzogs byed bde 'gror skye yang sdug bsngal 'byung*// ngan 'gror skyes kyang phun tshogs dge sdig mthu// phan byed re la rdzogs byed (171)gnyis re yis// mu bzhir 'gyur la las gcig skye ba gcig

/phan gyi du ma mi 'phen rdzogs byed la// du ma yod kyang du ma gcig mi 'phen// gtan dbab bsdu ba srog gcod byas pa la// ma bsags pa ni mi mkhas pas byas dang*// rmi lam byas dang ched du ma byas dang*// mi 'dod gzhan gyi nan du byed bcug dang*// lan gcig kho na byas shing 'gyod pa dang*// nyes dmigs dran pas spang ba'i sdom pa blang*// 'jig rten lam gyi sa bon nyams smad dang*// 'das pa'i lam gyis sa bon bcom pa'o// bsags la ma byas bsam la sbyor ma rtsom// byas la bsags pa snga ma gnyis ma gtogs// ma byas ma bsags gsum po de ma gtogs// ma byin len nas ngag kyal bar de bzhin// yid kyi gsum las gnyis pa dang po la'ang*// ched du ma byas gzhan gyis byed bcug med// las de'i 'bras bu tshe 'dir smin pa ni// mthong chos myong ba de yang brgyad yod de// lus dang longs spyod srid pa la blta ba// shas che'i sems pas mi dge tshe 'dir myong*// gnod sems che dang bla ma dkon mchog la// mnar sems che dang phan 'dogs pa la 'khu// byas pa mi bzo'i (172)bsam pa'i mi dge ba// de ldog dge ba tshe 'dir myong ba'o// skyes nas myong 'gyur tshe gnyis pa ma myong*// lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur tshe gsum phan// las gang lci ba de ni thog mar smin// nyams na 'chi dus mngon du gyur de smin// de yang 'dra na goms pa shas che ba// mnyam na thog mar byas pa sngon la smin// da lta'i rgyud dang dam pa'i chos gnyis ni// nam mkha' dang ni sa gzhi'i bar yang ring*// shar nub gnyis kyi ri bar de bas ring*// phal dang dam pa'i chos kyang de bas ring*// las 'bras bslu ba med pa myong ba'i tshe// nyes skyon ci 'byung le lan ma bdas par// las 'di byas pas 'dis skyes bsam par bya// nyes spyod rnams kyis ma gos pa ru 'bad// bag med nyon mongs mang bas nyes 'byung na// ji mi snyam par bzhag tu mi rung bas// sdom gsum so sor ltung ba phyir bcos bya// chos bzhi brtan las rnam par sun 'byin stobs// thog med sdig par 'gyod pa mang ba yin// lag tu blang tshe gser 'od dam pa dang*// sangs rgyas so lnga'i bshags pa gnyis bya'o// gnyen po kun spyod stobs la rnam pa drug

/ mdo sde zab mor brtan pa sher phyin klogs/ stong pa nyid la mos pa bdag med bsgom// bzlas (173)pa la brten yig brgya la sogs zlos// sku gzugs la brten sku gzugs byed pa'o// mchod pa la brten sangs rgyas dang mchod rten// mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa'o// mtshan la brten pa sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi// mtshan thos gzungs sogs bslab btus las gsungs ltar// nyes pa ldog stobs yang dag sdom pa ste// rten stobs skyabs 'gro byang sems bsgom pa'o// ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i las rnams bshags pa 'dis// mgo bo tsha ba tsam gyis 'dag par 'gyur// nyes pas ma gos pa dang dag pa gnyis// khyad par che ste tshe der sa dang por// thob par mi srid par ni byang sar gsungs// lam gyi rten gyur skyes bu chung ngu dang*// thun mong gi skabs so// de nas 'bring dang thun mong 'khor ba yi// lha mi'i go 'phang thob kyang 'du byed kyi// sdug bsngal de la rang bzhin bde ba 'dzin// phyin ci log yin don la bde ba med// slar yang ngan 'gror ltung bas mtha' ngan phyir// bde 'gro la ni ngan 'gro 'dra bar ni// srid pa'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa gnad du che// thar pa bcings pa las ni grol ba ste// de yang las dang nyon mongs 'ching byed yin// phung po nyin mtshams sbyor ba 'ching ba ste// de las grol (174)ba thar pa zhes bya'o// de nyid 'thob 'dod thar pa don gnyer blo// de ni 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes dgos la// de'i rgyu spang bya de las thar pa thob// der 'gro'i lam ni brten bya bden pa bzhi// dang po skye ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la// sdug bsngal ldan zhing gnas ngan len dang ldan// sdug bsngal gnas 'gyur nyon mongs gnas su 'gyur// mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral ba'i chos nyid yin// rga ba'i sdug bsngal gzugs bzang yongs su nyams// mthu stobs dbang po yul la longs spyod che// na ba'i sdug bsngal lus kyi rang bzhin 'gyur// shas cher gnas dang yid 'ong yul mi 'dod// yid du mi 'ong mi 'dod bzhin du spyod// srog gi dbang po 'bral bar 'gyur ba'o// 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal longs spyod rtsa 'dzing dang*// 'khor dang lus sdug phun tshogs 'bral ba dang*// sdug bsngal yid mi bde ba drag po myong*// mi sdug 'phrad dang sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*// 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed mi chad pa// mdor na nyer len phung po sdug bsngal snod// dgra gnyen nges med 'dod pa ngoms mi shes// yang yang lus 'dor yang yang nying mtshams sbyor// yang yang mtho dman grogs med nyes pa'o// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal 'bras sam phol mig las// chu bsil btab ltar tshor ba bde ba dang*/

(175)/sdug bsngal sdug bsngal de la tshwa chu sogs// 'gyur byed dang 'phrad tshor ba sdug bsngal dang*// reg pa gnyis bral tshor ba btang snyoms pa// gnas ngan len 'brel 'du byed sdug bsngal lo// de dag tshor ba mtshungs ldan sems sems byung*// gang la dmigs yul zag bcas rnams kyang ngo*// tshor ba bde bas chags pa rgyas pa dang*// sdug bsngal skyes pas khong khro 'phel ba dang*// btang snyoms rtag 'dzin la sogs gti mug rgyas// de rnams sdug bsngal bltas pas dug gsum dag /dper na khur chen ji tsam khur dgos pa// de tsam bde ba med pa bzhin du yang*// nyer len phung po'i khur yang ji srid du// bzung dgos de srid sdug bsngal bar 'gyur te// 'du byed sdug bsngal sdug bsngal thams cad la// khyab pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis rtsa ba yin// de phyir 'di la skyo ba mang du bsgom// mi yi sdug bsngal bkres skom tsha grang dang*// tshor 'gro ngal dang skye rga na 'chi bdun// lha min sdug bsngal lha la phrag dog dang*// lha la 'thab pas lus ni bcad dang dral// rnam smin sgrib pas bden pa mthong du med// 'di ni dran nyer dud 'gro rnam par spyod// sa las lha yi 'gro bar bshad pa'o// 'dod lhar 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// bsod nams chen po gzhan gyi spa bkong dang*/ (176)/mgo bo bcad dang yan lag dral ba dang*// lha stobs ldan pas spyug cing skrod par byed// gong ma'i lha la sdug bsngal de dag med// 'on kyang nyon mongs ldan zhing sgrib pa bcas// 'chi 'pho ba dang gnas la rang dbang med// de dag gnas ngan len gyi sdug bsngal lo// kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim sems pa la// las nyon gnyis las nyon mongs gtso bo yin// nyon mongs med na sdug bsngal mi 'grub cing*// nyon mongs yod na slar yang 'byung phyir ro// gang skyes sems rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar// byed pa gang yin nyon mongs mtshan nyid yin// 'dod chags yid du 'ong la rjes su chags// khong khro sdug bsngal gnas la gnod par sems// nga rgyal sems khengs mtho ba'i rnam pa can// ma rig bden bzhi las 'bras dkon mchog la// blo mi gsal bas mi shes nyon mongs can// the tshom bden pa sogs la yin min snyam// 'jig lta phung por dmigs nas bdag tu lta// 'jig pa mi rtag pa dang tshogs pa la// rtag gcig gang zag med ces bstan pa'i phyir// mthar lta bdag la dmigs nas rtag pa'am// nying mtshams sbyor ba med pa'i chad par lta// lta ba mchog 'dzin 'jig mthar log lta gsum// gang rung lta po'i phung po la dmigs nas// mchog tu (177)'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can// tshul brtul mchog 'dzin sdig dag nyon mongs spang*// srid las nges 'byin shes rab nyon mongs can// log lta tshe ni snga phyi las 'bras med// skur pa 'debs dang dbang phyug gtso bo sogs// 'gro ba'i rgyur 'dzin shes rab nyon mongs can// rtsa nyon bcu po kun btus sogs las gsungs// ma rig 'jig lta nyon mongs rtsa ba yin// bdag gzhan 'dzin pas chags sdang la sogs skye// nyon mongs nyes dmigs shes nas skyon du blta// mdo rgyan spyod 'jug gsungs ltar sems pa yin// nyon mongs mtshan nyid shes phyir mngon pa mnyan// nyon mongs gang rung skyes na ngos bzung gin// nyon mongs pa dang 'thab pa yin no gsungs// des ni las gsog tshul la gsag bya'i las// sems pa yid kyi las dang bsam pa'i las// lus ngag gnyis ka sems par dbyig gnyen bshad// zag bcas dge dang mi dge 'dod khams dang*// mi g.yo las ni gong ma'i sas bsdus pa'o// las de gang zag bdag 'dzin de srid du// 'phen byed las gsog bdag med rtogs nas ni// las nyon dbang gis 'khor bar skye na yang*// 'phen byed las ni gsar du mi gsog go

/'chi 'pho (178)nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshul la yang*// las kyi 'phangs pa'i tshe zad 'chi ba dang*// yo byad med pa bsod nams zad pa dang// ya nga ma spang 'chi la rgyu rkyen dgu// zas kyis 'greng tshe mi 'phrod za ba dang*// ma zhu za dang 'byin par mi byed dang*// smin pa bsgags dang sman ni mi brten dang*// goms dang ma goms mi shes dus min 'gro// mi tshangs spyod de dgu po mdo las gsungs// 'chi ba'i sems ni dge dang mi dge dang*// bar ma'i sems gsum bde sdug bar ma myong*// kun kyang bdag la chags dang de'i dbang gis// bdag ni med 'gyur lus la dga' ba ni// bar do 'grub pa'i rgyu yin drod sdud tshul// mi dge byed la dang po ro stod grang*// dge ba byed pa smad grang gnyis ka yang*// snying ga nas ni rnam shes 'pho bar byed// shi nas bar do srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin// bar do de yang mig sogs dbang po tshang*// gang du skye 'gyur lus kyi rnam pa can// skye ba ma blang bar du lha mig ltar// lus kyang rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing thogs pa med// mi dge byed pa'i bar srid mun nag snang*// dge ba'i bar srid mtshan mo'i zla 'od bzhin// rigs mthun rnams dang rang gi skye gnas mthong*// de yang dmyal ba sdong dum tshig pa dang*// dud 'gro du ba yi dwags chu lta bu// (179)'dod pa'i lha mi gser dang gzugs khams dkar// gzugs med shi sar lus grub bar do med// lha ni gyen dang mi ni thad kar 'gro// nyes pa'i las byed bar do spyi'u tshugs 'gro// tshe tshad de ltar thogs na zhag bdun dang*// skye rkyen ma rnyed lus brjes bdun phrag bdun// de las ring par 'dod pa mi rigs so// de nas skye srid nyid mtshams sbyor tshul ni// mngal du skye na nyal po byed mthong nas// mor skye skyes par chags cing phor skye na// bud med la chags skyes pa 'bral bar 'dod// rim par mtshan ma gnyis la gzhan mi mthong*// der khros bar srid 'chi 'pho skye ba len// de yang pha ma 'dod chags drag po'i mjug

khu ba ska ba'i rjes la khu khrag gi /thigs pa gnyis 'byung ma yi skye gnas su// 'dres nas chags dang lhan cig bar srid 'gags// rnam shes zhugs pa nying mtshams sbyor ba'o// de yang zhag ni bdun phrag so brgyad kyis// lus rdzogs de nas zhag bzhi lon nas btsa'// drod gsher skye ba dri 'dod brdzus skyes la// gnas 'dod tsha dmyal skye na dro ba 'dod// grang dmyal bsil 'dod rgong skyes mngal skyes 'dra// rten 'brel bcu gnyis sgo nas bsam pa ni// ma rig rig pa'i 'gal zla mi mthun phyogs// dbye na las 'bras de kho na nyid (180)rmongs// byed las ngan 'gro bde 'gro'i 'du byed gsog /'du byed las yin dge sdig mi g.yo gsum// rnam shes tshogs drug gtso bo kun gzhi'am// yid shes yin zhing rgyu dus 'bras dus gnyis// ming ni tshor 'du 'du byed rnam shes bzhi// gzugs ni sems can mer mer la sogs pa// skye mched drug ni mig sogs bzhi po grub// lus dang yid ni mer mer dus na yod// brdzus te skye na dbang po gcig char 'grub// ming gzugs lus kyi ngo bo skye mched drug lus kyi khyad par longs spyod po yang grub// skye mched gzugs can lnga ni gzugs med spang*// reg pa yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus nas// yul gyi 'gyur ba yongs su gcod pa'o// tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum skyes pa// srid pa tshor bde mi 'bral sdug bsngal la// 'bral 'dod skye la ma rig pa med na// tshor ba yod kyang sred pa mi skye'o// len pa yul rnam bzhi la 'dun zhing chags// gzugs sogs 'dod yon 'jig tshogs lta ba dang*// de gzhan lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs la// 'dun zhing chags pa nye bar len pa'o// srid pa sngar gyi 'du byed gyis rnam shes// las kyis bag chags bsgos pa sred len gyis// gsos btab yang srid 'dren pa'i mthu can gyur//

(181)skye ba skye gnas bzhi po nying mtshams sbyor// rga ba phung po smin cing gzhan du 'gyur// shi ba phung po'i ris mthun dor ba'o// gang 'phangs 'bras dus rnam shes nas tshor ba// yan lag phyed dang lnga'o gang gis 'phangs// ma rig pa la brten pa'i 'du byed kyis// ji ltar 'phangs na rgyu dus rnam shes la// las gyis bag chags bsgos pa'i tshul gyis so// 'phangs pa'i don ni 'grub byed yod na ni// 'grub rung byas la gang gis 'grub byed na// srid pa'i rkyen gyis len pa gang 'grub na// skye ba rga shi ji ltar 'grub byed na// nus pa mthu can byas pa'i tshul gyis so// dang po brgyad dgu nyon mongs gnyis bcu las// lhag ma bdun ni sdug bsngal lam yin no// tshe du la rdzogs ma rig 'du byed dang*// rgyu dus rnam shes sred len srid pa rdzogs// phyi mar 'phang pa phyed lnga grub pa gnyis// yang na 'grub byed grub pa 'phen byed gsum// nyon mongs gsum las las gnyis de las ni// sdug bsngal bdun 'byung bdun las nyon mongs sogs// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad med par 'khor// nyon mongs med na mi 'byung nyon mongs spangs// dal 'byor rten la rab tu byung nas ni// bstan pa'i rtsa (182)ba so sor thar la gus// sems g.yeng med par byed pa tshul khrims yin// mnyam par 'jog pa ting 'dzin bslab pa dang*// grol bar byed pa shes rab bslab pa ste// gsum gyi 'bras bu lha ma'i khams gong ma// thar pa yin pas lhag pa'i bslab la 'bad// 'du ba sngags gnyis gcig grogs gcig lo ba// bka' rgyud 'di pa las med ston pas gsungs// tshul khrims dag byed nyon mongs 'thab pa gces// tha ma dgra dang nyon mongs 'dra ba min// nyon mongs lan gcig spang thub slar mi 'ong*// 'on kyang bdag cag brtson pa med pas len// gti mug gnyen por rten 'brel 'jug ldog dang*// sdang la bzod pa sred la mi sdug pa// gzhan yang rnyed grags bstod bde bzhi la sred// ldog byed bzhi la sdang ba'i gnyen por 'bad// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs 'chi ba dran pa rnams// gnad du song na 'di dag ldog par 'gyur// nga rgyal lam gyi gegs dang bran gyi rgyu// yin pas spong tshul las 'bras nges pas so// gnyid rmugs rgod dang le lo bag maid dang*// khrel dang ngo tsha med dang brjed ngas sogs// shes bzhin ma yin nye nyon rnams byung na// nyes dmigs dran pas 'phral du bzlog la brtson// ma nus na yang nyon mongs kha mi skyor// phyogs mi 'dzin dang dgrar blta (183)ba zhig ni// da lta med du mi rung gnyen po'i phyogs// bzung la nyon mongs sun 'byin rang gis gang*// khas blang tshul khrims yongs su dag par byas/

/skyes bu 'bring gi lam rim gyi skabs so/ /de ltar 'khor ba las grol thar pa thob// mtho ris dpal ltar ldog pa ma yin no// skyon zad yon tan thob pa phyogs re ba// yin pa rang gi don yang ma rdzogs la// gzhan gyi don yang nyi tshe bar zad cing*// mthar ni sangs rgyas kyis bskul theg chen du// 'jug dgos pas na blo ldan rnams kyis ni// thog mar theg pa chen por 'jug par rigs// rgyal bas pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi// theg pa chen po gnyis las gzhan ma gsungs// de gnyis 'jug sgo byang sems kho na yin// rgyud la skyes na theg chen sar 'jog cing*// de dang bral na theg chen pa las nyams// byang chub sems ni dkar po'i sa bon te// stong nyid rtogs pa chu lud sogs dang 'dra// byang chub sems ni sangs rgyas sa bon la// gzhan ni byang chub gsum ga'i thun mong rgyu// byang chub sems ni pha yi sa bon la// bdag med shes rab ma dang 'dra ba ste// shes rab theg pa che chung 'byed min te// byang chub sems dang spyod pas 'byed pa yin// de phyir (184)shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas thabs shes rab// ya bral lam gyis gang yang phyin mi 'gyur// sems de skye ba'i rkyen la rnam pa bzhi// cho 'phrul ngo mtshar mthong ngam thos pa las// ya mtshan skyes dang sangs rgyas yon tan thos// theg chen bstan pa nub na mi bzod dang*// don chen sems de dkon par mthong nas kyang*// des bskul sangs rgyas thob 'dod skyes pa ste// rang don phun tshogs sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// des na gzhan don lta zhog rang don la// med mi rung bar mthong nas theg dman ldog /sems bskyed pa ni gzhan phyir byang chub 'dod// rgyu ni rigs bzang bshes zin snying rje dang*// 'khor bar mi skyo la brten sems bskyed pa'o// stobs ni rdzogs byang 'dod pa rang gi stobs// gzhan mthus rdzogs byang 'dod pa gzhan gyi stobs// sngon goms bsngags pa thos pa rgyu yi stobs// dge la ring du goms par sbyor ba'i stobs// rang gi rgyu las brtan cing gzhan mi brtan// rang stobs bsam pa thag pas sems bskyed cing*// byang chub spyod pa thams cad 'di la brten// byang chub sems de sbyang ba'i rim pa ni// jo bo nas brgyud man ngag rgyu 'bras bdun// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems las byung*// de ni lhag bsam snying rje byams pa dang*// drin gzo drin dran mar mthong ba las byung*// theg chen (185)lam gyi rtsa ba snying rje yin// sgrol ba ma lus sgrol ba'i khur 'khyer dang*// bya dka'i spyod la 'jug pa'i rten yang yin// bar du gzhan don mi skyo tshogs rdzogs byed// tha ma 'bras dus nam mkha' ji srid du// 'gro don mdzad pa'ang snying rje chen po'i mthu// mar shes drin dran drin las bzo ba gsum// yid du 'ong ba'i bces pa sgrub byed yin// sdug par 'dzin pa'i byams pa snying rje ni// snga ma rnams kyi 'bras bu'i tshul du 'byung*// snying rje las ni sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi// byang chub sems skye de las sems can gyi// bde ba bsgrub dang sdug bsngal sel ba yi// khur du len pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa bskyed// mi gtsang dong du bu gcig pu lhung na// mas ni smre sngags 'don gyi gdon mi nus// de ni nyan rang la yod pha lta bu'i// byang chub sems dpas mi gtsang dong nas ston// lhag pa'i bsam pa khyad par 'phags pa bskyed// sems can bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa// mtshungs na nye ring bzung nas phan gnod ni// byed pa mi rigs 'khor bar thog med nas// bdag gi gnyen du lan brgyar ma gyur med// snyam nas tshad med btang snyoms sgom par bya// der yang ma zad 'khor bar brgyud pa'i tshe// sngar yang (186)ma byas ma 'ongs byed par 'gyur// ma byas dus su gnod pa thams cad bskyabs// phan bde thams cad bsgrub cing khyad par du// 'dir yang dang po mngal du yun ring bzung*// btsas pa'i dus su spu ser zeng nge zhig

/sha yi drod bcar sor bcus kha la g.yengs// nu zho bsnun cing nom bu kha yis bsnyod// snabs lud khas 'jibs mi gtsang lag pas phyis// sna tshogs thabs kyis skyo ngal med par gsos// de yang bkres skom dus su bza' btung dang*// khyag dus gos dang 'phongs pa'i dus su nor// rang gi spyad mi bra ba rnams kyang byin// yo byad de rnams bde blag rnyed nas min// sdig sdug gtam ngan bsres kyin sha thang du// btsal nas byin dang bu la na tsha las// rang nyid shi bar 'dam zhing sbyor bas gsal// mdor na shes tshad nus tshad phan bde bsgrub// gnod dang sdug bsngal bsal ba'i drin rnams dran// skye shi 'phos pa ngo ma shes pa las// bdag ni pha ma drin chen skyabs med rnams// gtsis med dor nas rang nyid 'khor ba las// ci thar byed na de las khrel ba ci// ma rnams srid pa'i 'jigs las sgrol nas kyang*// thar pa myang 'das bde la 'god par bya// snyam du phan len ldog pa'i drin bzo bya// bde ba mi ldan sems can thams cad ni// bde ba ldan na dga' dang smon pa dang*// dam bca' ba ste (187)'brel ba sum ldan no// byams pas lha mi'i byams shing ngang gi 'du// rgyal bas bdud sde byams pas pham mdzad pas// bsrung ba'i mchog tu gyur sogs phan yon che// sdug bsngal can gyi sems can thams cad ni// sdug bsngal de dag bral na ci ma rung*// bral bar gyur cig bral bar bya'o snyoms// de rnams bsgom pa'i go rim thog ma ru// mdza' bshes rnams dang bar ma dgra rnams la// rim par phyogs bcu'i sems can rnams la bsgom// snying rje goms pa'i stobs kyis byang chub sems// bsgrim mi dgos par ngang gis skye bar 'gyur// sdug cing yid du 'ong ba'i sems can rnams// bde bas phongs dang sdug bsngal gyis mnar na// 'di dag ji ltar bde dang 'phrad pa dang*// sdug bsngal las ni thar bar bya snyam du// de dag sgrol ba'i khur chen bdag gis khyer// snyam du blo sbyong mnyam rjes kun tu bya// shin tu kha ba'i tig ta'i sdong po la// bur khu thigs pa re re tsam blugs pas// mngar por mi nus nyon mongs ro kha bas// thog med nas bsgos rgyud la byams snying rjes// yun thung res bsgom ci yang mi 'gyur bas// rgyun ldan skyong ba gdams ngag mthil du bzung*// zhi ba lha yi lugs ltar sbyang ba la// bdag gces 'dzin pa rgud pa kun kyi sgo// gzhan gces 'dzin pa phun tshogs thams cad gnas//

(188)bdag la gzhan bzhin gzhan la bdag bzhin lta// pha ma'i khu khrag las grub gzhan lus la// ngar 'dzin skye ltar gzhan lus gces 'dzin bya// rang gces 'dzin dang gzhan yal bar 'dod gnyis// go sa brjes te gzhan la gces par 'dzin// bdag la yal bar 'dor ba'i blo bskyed pa// bdag gces dgrar bltas bdag bde byed pa 'gog /gzhan gces yon tan gzhan sdug sel la 'bad// bdag gzhan tha dad yin pas min zhe na// bdag gzhan ltos nas bzhag pa tsam yin gyi// rang gi ngo bos grub pa med par gsungs// gzhan sdug bdag la mi gnod mi bsal na// rkang pa'i sdug bsngal lag pas mi sel 'gyur// bdag gces 'dis ni sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig 'byung*// gzhan gces bzung nas sangs rgyas phun tshogs thob// de bas rang kha mi 'dzin phyogs mi skyor// rang gi lus dang longs spyod dge rtsa rnams// ltos pa med par sems can rnams la gtong*// gang la btang ba de yi don bya zhing*// rang gi don du dmigs pa'i blo mi bya// gzhan la gces shing 'phangs pa sdug pa dang*// yid du 'ong ba ci skye'i sgo nas ni// gzhan la gces par 'dzin pa bskyed par bya// sems can zhing la sbyin sogs btang ba las/ (189)/sangs rgyas chos 'grub phyir na gzhan gces 'dzin// gzhan phan ches cher goms nas brten gyur na// brlabs chen spyod par rang dbang med par 'jug /theg pa chen po'i rtsa ba tshugs mi chugs// theg chen gseb tu bcos min chud mi chud// thams cad 'di la thug pas dus kun tu// 'di la blo skyed ci byung bltas nas su// skyes na legs la ma skyes na de ltar// mi bsdad de ltar ston pa'i bshes la brten// blo sbyong bya ba'i grogs dang rtag tu 'grogs// de ltar ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel blta// de'i rgyu tshogs bsags de'i gegs sgrib pa sbyong*// de ltar blo sbyong nyi zla lta bu yis// rin chen byang chub sems mchog skye bar 'gyur// cho gas bzung la ma thob 'thob byed ni// mtshan ldan bshes la lha klu dang bcas pas// gnas brgyan rten bkram mchod rdzas bshams pa dang*// gsol ba btab cing skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// tshogs bsags pa dang bsam pa sbyang la brtson// dngos bzhi brjod pa gsum dang 'jug chog go

/thob pa mi nyams bsrung la bslab bya ni// sems mchog bskyed nas spyod la ma bslab na// 'tshang rgya mi srid pas na spyod la bslab// sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i thabs la 'jug de yang*// rgyu rkyen tshang la ma nor ba dgos te// (190)snying rje byang chub sems dang sbyin sogs thabs// yongs su rdzogs la ka ma shī las bshad// des nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'dod phyin chad// lam la thabs shes gnyis char brten dgos kyi// ya bral gyis ni mi 'grub phyogs re spang*// stong nyid las gzhan mi dgos smra na ni// rang gi ston pa'i sngon gyi skyes pa'i rabs// bzang po rnams la skur ba 'debs pa yin// khyad par sa brgyad skabs su nyon mongs zad// spros pa zhi ba'i don dam la gnas tshe// sangs rgyas rnams kyis rtogs pa 'di tsam ni// nyan rang la yod nged kyi sku ye shes// tshad med pa sogs khyed la med pas na// brtson 'grus rtsom sogs spyod pa bslab dgos par// bshad na ting 'dzin phra mos chog shes pa// 'di ni mkhas pa'i bzhad gad gnas yin no// bslab pa'i gzhi ni pha rol phyin drug la// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya thams cad 'dus// grang nges tshul ni mdo sde'i rgyan las gsungs// rang gi sangs rgyas chos smin phar phyin dang*// gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa bsdu dngos bzhi// de la sbyin pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na// gtong ba'i sems pa dge des kun slong ba'i// lus ngag las yin phyir na rdzogs pa ni// 'gro ba dbul ba bor la mi ltos te// da dung 'gro bkren yod na skyob pa (191)rnams// pha rol ma phyin des na lus dang ngag /ma yin sems gtso rtogs pa'i gegs gyur pa// ser sna bsal dang bdog pa thams cad ni// gzhan la gtong ba'i bsam pa snying nas bskyed// dbye ba dam pa drug ni rten dam pa// byang chub sems kyi kun nas bslangs pa'o// dngos po dam pa sbyin pa'i dngos po spyod// khyad par 'jug kyang de yi bsam pa ldan// ched du bya ba sems can thams cad la// 'phral du bde dang phugs su phan pa'i phyir// thabs mkhas dam pa rnam par mi rtog gam// rang bzhin med rtogs shes rab zin la bya// bsngo ba dam pa dge ba rdzogs byang bsngo// rnam dag dam pa nyon shes sgrib pa 'gog

/theg pa chen po bsdus pa las bshad do// nang gses pha rol phyin pa drug dang ldan// zang zing khyim pa chos sbyin rab byung gis// bya bar gsungs kyang 'byor pa yod na gtong*// sbyin pa'i ngo bo'i dbye ba rnam pa gsum// chos kyi sbyin dang mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin// zang zin sbyin pa gang gi gtong ba'i zhing*// phan 'dogs mdza' bshes gnod byed dgra bo dang*// tha mal ba dang yon tan skyon can dang*// rang las dma' dang mnyam dang lhag pa dang*// 'byor zhing skyid la sdug cing phongs pa'o// bsam pa bla med byang chub chen po'i (192)tshogs// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par bya'o snyam// dgos par dmigs dang dang por sems bskyed nas// bdog pa thams cad gzhan la btang zin pas// bcol ba len ltar dngos po dmigs pa dang*// sbyin yul dge ba'i bshes su zhing la dmigs// spyi dang bye brag gnod pa phyed pa la// byams pa'i sems dang sdug bsngal snying rje'i sems// yon tan can la dga' ba'i bsam pa dang*// phan 'dogs rnams la btang snyoms bsam pas sbyin// zhing rnams la'ang sems ni snyom bya zhing*// sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yul la gtong ba dang*// khyad par sdug bsngal can la brtse bar bya// sbyin la 'bras bu med do snyam pa sogs// lta ngan mchog 'dzin brnyas dang rlom sems khengs// snyan grags re ba 'gyod dang rgya chen zhum// phyogs ris byed pas rgyab phyogs phan 'dogs re// phyi ma rnam smin blta dang gtong phod can// shes pa la sogs log 'tsho'i bsam pa med// slong ba po yis log bsgrub skyo ba spang*// sbyor ba gsog pa'i ring la slong ba bzlog /da gdod bslang ba kha gcig ster ba min// des ni ser sna la sogs nyon mongs bskyed// bsrung sogs tshogs kyi dge ba'i bya ba bcag /bar skabs brlag 'gyur sbyin pa mi 'grub phyir// bzhin gyi mdangs gsal 'dzum pa sngar byed la// gsong por smra na ci 'dra'i zhing la'ang*//

(193)gus dang ldan pas rang gi lag gis ster// gzhan la gnod dang dka' spyad sdug bsngal bsran// rang gi gtong zhing gzhan la gtong bar bskul// dngos po btang des 'phral du bde ba bskyed// phugs su phan pa dge la 'god pa dang*// 'phral gnod phugs su phan yang gzhan la btang*// 'phral phugs gnod cing 'phral bde phugs gnod kyang*// byang sems ldan pas gzhan la gtong mi bya// dus kyi sgo nas btang du mi rung ba// las dang po yi rang sha sogs mi ster// dgos pa ser sna bral zhing gzhan don bsgrub// dgos pa mi ldan yan lag sogs mi sbyin// nyes spyod phyir du rang nyid sbyin mi bya// slong ba bdud ris lhas ni tho mtshams dang*// smyon pa sogs la ma byin ltung ba med// de ma gtogs par slong na sbyin par bya// rab byung sogs la phyi dro'i zas mi ster// sdom brtson can la rgog gtsong sha chang dang*// byas pa mi bzo bran la sogs pa dang*// nor gyi 'du shes byed la glegs bam rnams// sbyin par mi bya bar ni byang sar gsungs// ser sna'i dri ma bsal mi dgos pa dang*// ma byin pa la tshogs mang mthong ba dang*// sems can thams cad dga' bar byed nus na// chung ngu'i phyir du chen po mi btang ngo*// brlang pos ma yin 'jam (194)pos bzlog par bya// dngos po chos gos gsum sogs sangs rgyas kyis// rjes su gnang ba rnams ni sbyin mi bya// dgos pa gnod pa'i rgyur 'gyur btang mi bya// de dag ma gtogs thams cad sbyin par bya// slong ba 'byor dang bkren pa gnyis byung na// gnyis ka'i bkren pa'i 'dod pa rdzogs par bya// sbyin pa'i gegs kyi gnyen po brten pa la// sbyin par mi 'dod pa yi nyes pa 'di// bdag sngon sbyin la ma goms pa yin pas// goms par bya phyir da lta sbyin dgos so// rgud pas mi sbyin sngon las shes nas kyang*// gzhan la phan na 'chi yang sbyin dgos snyam// yid 'ong rdzas mi sbyin na chags pa yin// nyes dmigs dran nas dngos de sbyin par bya// rdzogs byang phyir min longs spyod la bltas na// thar pa mi thob byang chub chen por bsngo// bsam pas sbyin bya sna tshogs sprul nas kyang*// sems can rnams la sbyin par mos pa byed// tshegs chung don che lag bzang zhus las gsungs// sa mtho'i sbyin pa smon pa'i yul du sbyong*// da lta'i 'jug ldog gnang bkag shes nas bslab// khyad par lus dang longs spyod dge rtsa gtong*// byang sems rjes dran byang chub smon lam 'debs// tshul khrims ngo bo gzhan gnod gzhir bcas las// yid phyir log pa'i spong sems tshul khrims yin// sems (195)can gnod 'tshe bral la mi ltos kyi// bdag gis spang sems goms par byed pa nyid// tshul khrims ma dag nyams na ngan 'gror ltung*// gzhan don lta zhog rang 'dod mi 'grub pas// de phyir tshul khrims gces spras lhod mi bya// tshul khrims 'gal zla mi dge bcu'i nyes dmigs// sngar bshad ltar bsam phan yon mtha' yas kyang*// rgyud ni khyad 'phags sems dpa' rnams dang mtshungs// ye shes thob dang rgyan dang dri yi mchog

/tshul khrims ldan na yon tan phul du byung*// longs spyod skye bo kun kyang ngang gi 'du// skye bos byams la zhabs rdul lha yis mchod// mkhas pa'i rgyan ldan sngags pa'i tshul khrims gsungs// ngan song 'jigs dang lha mi'i phun tshogs la// smon pa bsal nas 'gro kun tshul khrims la// 'god pa'i phyir du nan tan chen pos bsrungs// dbye na sdom dang chos sdud don byed gsungs// dang po so thar thun mong bcas rang bzhin// kha na ma tho spong ba'i tshul khrims yin// gnyis pa phyin drug ma skyes bskyed pa dang*// skyes zin mi nyams gong nas gong du spel// gsum pa sems can don rnams ji rigs bsgrub// des na so sor thar pa'i bcas pa rnams// byang sems rab byung bslab bya'i phyogs gcig yin// de las byang sems bslab bya (196)zur pa med// so thar sdom pa 'jug ldog byed pa nyid// tshul khrims phyi ma gnyis kyi gzhi yang yin// gtso bo rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba// nyes dmigs che ba mi dge bcu spong yin// dam pa drug dang phar phyin drug ldan 'dra// sa mtho'i nyams len smon pa'i yul du bya/ las dang po yi tshul khrims spyi dang ni// khyad par mi dge bcu la sdom sems dang*// de dag nang nas sdom pa khas blangs ba'i// rtsa ltung rnams la sdom sems yang yang bya// byed pa rgyu mthun skye ba gzhan du yang*// tshul khrims dag par 'gyur bas 'bad par bya// bzod pa'i ngo bo gnod pa byed pa la// ji mi snyam dang sdug bsngal dang du len// chos la nges par sems la mos pa brtan// khro ba 'gog pa'i sems kyi goms pa rdzogs// sems can mi bsrun bral la ltos mi dgos// yon tan mdzes ldan mtshan rab brgyan pa yin// gzugs sgrub bzo yi gnas kyang bzod pa yin// bsgrim te khro 'joms 'di dang gzhan du bde// 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo las kyang*// bskal pa brgyar bsags dge ba khong khros 'joms// spyod 'jug las ni stong gi 'joms par gsungs// dge rtsa 'joms pa'i khong khro mgal ba la// skyes pas 'joms na shes ldan ci la smros//

(197)khong khros yid zhi mi myong dga' dang bde// mi 'thob gnyid mi 'ong zhing brten mi 'gyur// drin gyis skyong yang mi mdza' skyo bar 'gyur// mdor na khro bas bder gnas 'ga' yang med// bzod pa'i rab dbye la yang rnam pa gsum// gzhan gyis log sgrub bzod pa bskyed pa la// bde ba'i gegs dang sdug bsngal bskyed pa dang*// gnod pa byed la khro ba mi rigs te// gnod pa byed 'dod bsam pa sngon btang nas// sbyor ba sdug bsngal bskyed pas khro snyam na// de la rang dbang yod dam med pas yin// rang dbang med de sngon goms nyon mongs kyi// sa bon yod pas yul dang nye ba yis// tshul min yid byed rgyu dang rkyen tshogs pas// gnod sems bskyed do snyam du ma bsam yang*// rgyu rkyen dag gis bskyed bar 'gyur ba'i phyir// rgyu rkyen ma tshang bsam yang mi skye'i phyir// de bas nyon mongs gzhan gyi dbang gyur pas// bran ltar song phyir khro bar mi rigs te// gdon gyis brlams pas phan 'dogs byed mkhan la// brdeg sogs byed kyang de la mi khro bzhin// byang sems des kyang gnod pa byed pa la// nyon mongs gdon gyis dbang med byas snyam nas// cung zad mi khro nyon mongs de bral phyir// bdag gi byang sems spyod la 'bad pa bskyed// sems can (198)'ga' la rang dbang yod na ko /sdug bsngal mi 'dod phyir na 'gag pa dang*// g.yang du mchong sogs byed par mi rigs na// de byed gzhan la gnod pa smos ci dgos/ khro de sems can rang bzhin yin na ni// tsha zhing bsreg pa'i me la khro mi rigs// glo bur yin na mkha' la dud 'thul bkon// dngos la khro na dbyug pa la khro rigs// rgyud la khro na zhe sdang la khro dgos// de yang rang gis las kyis bskul ba yin// rang gi lan pas khro ba dgag par bya// da lta'i sdug bsngal phra mo mi bzod na// ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal rgyu ni nan gyis bskyed// gnod pa byung na sngon gyi las ngan 'dzad// bzod pa byas na bsod nams mang po 'phel// phan btags drin du mi blta su zhig khro// phan tshun rmongs pas gnod dang khro gyur na// de la skyon bcas skyon med gang gis bya// nyan rang sogs kyis khro bar mi byed na// gzhan don zhugs pas khro ba ga la bskyed// sems can rnams la brtse ba bskyed dgos kyi/

khro dang gnod lan byed du ga la rung*// bstod dang grags snyan rnyed bkur nyams par byed// de ni ngan 'gro bsrung byed sangs rgyas kyi// byin rlabs lta bur gyur pas dga' bar bya// brnyas dang tshig rtsub mi snyan pa yis ni// lus la mi gnod sems khyod ci phyir khro// sems can (199)phan bde bsgrub phyir sems bskyed nas// sems can bde ba rnyed la khro ba dang*// rgud la dga' ba'i bsam ngan dgag par bya// de ltar rang dang rang gi gnyen bshes la// 'dod pa'i gegs byed mi 'dod phyogs bsgrub dang*// dgra yi phun tshogs mi 'dod rnam par bltas// de las yid mi bde dang zhe sdang bskyed// mi 'dod bzlog na khong khro 'gag par byed// sdug bsngal dang len bzod pa bskyed pa la// rang cag sdug bsngal gang rung rgyun du 'byung*// de ni lam du khyer shes med mi rung*// bcos su 'dug na mi dga' bya mi dgos// bcos med mi dga' byas kyang phan pa med// sdug bsngal med na nges 'byung mi skye bas// thar pa bskul dang dregs pa sel bar byed// sdig pa 'joms dang dge ba sgrub la dga'// snying rje skye ba yon tan rnam pa lnga// don med sdug bsngal tshad med bzod pas na// don chen bsgrub phyir sdug bsngal ci'i mi bzod// mi yi dka' spyad sdug bsngal phra mo 'dis// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzlog na cis ma legs// de bas gnod pa chung rim nas bzod na// gom san sla ba mi 'gyur yod ma yin// ci 'dra'i sdug bsngal dang du blang snyam na// gnas la brten pa 'tsho chas bsod snyoms sogs// tshangs spyod 'phel ba'i gnas rnams (200)brten pa dang*// de dag las byung sdug bsngal dang du len// mi rnyed mi snyan smad dang sdug bsngal dang*// 'jig zad rga na 'chi dgu 'jig rten chos// de rnams re re la brten sdug bsngal bzod// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam bzhi las ni// 'chag cing 'dug pas nyin mtshan sems sbyong na// dus ma yin par glos 'bebs nyal mi byed// dkon mchog bla ma mchod cing rim gro byed// chos rnams bzung dang bzung zin gzhan la ston/

kha ston bya dang dben par yang dag sems// zhi lhag bsgom ste chos 'dzin rnam pa bdun// de dag rtsol bas sdug bsngal byung na bzod// skra dang kha spu bregs sogs gzugs mi sdug /gos yang kha dog ngan pa 'jig rten pa'i// spyod pa bsdoms dang rnyed pas 'tsho ba dang*// gsog 'jog med dang mi tshangs spyod pa spang*// gar sogs spangs pa slong mos 'tsho ba bdun// de dag las byung sdug bsngal dang du len// dge la brtson pas lus sems ngal ba bzod// sems can don byed sdug bsngal dang du len// 'phral gyi bya ba las byung sdug bsngal bzod// chos la nges sems la mos bzod pa la// dang ba'i yul ni dkon mchog yon tan no// mngon du bya ba bdag med rnam pa gnyis// 'dod pa'i yul ni sras bcas (201)sangs rgyas kyi// mngon shes phyin drug lhan cig skyes pa'i mthu// blang dor yul ni legs spyad nyes spyad rgyu// bsgom pa'i yul ni byang chub lam dang bcas// thos bsam yul ni gsung rab bcu gnyis so// mos pa'i tshul ni yul gyi nges pa rnyed// mi mthun med pa yang yang sems pa'o// brtson 'grus ngo bo dge la spro ba'o// brtson 'grus kyis ni byang chub mchog sangs rgyas// brtson 'grus ldan pa nyon mongs kyis pham med// brtson 'grus med na le lo'i dbang du song*// chos kyis phongs shing skyes bu'i don rnams nyams// rab tu dbye na go cha'i brtson 'grus ni// bdag ni bskal pa stong du yun mnyam pa'i// nyin zhag bsags pa'i bskal pa grangs med gsum// bye ba 'bum 'gyur sems can gcig la ni// sdug bsngal bsal phyir dmyal bar gnas pas ni// sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur na'ang spro ba bskyed// rdzogs byang phyir du brtson 'grus mi gtong na// yun thung sdug bsngal chung la lta ci smos// gzhan yang lo 'bum song na byang sems gcig /skye zhing sangs rgyas gcig mthong de 'dra bar// gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma'i grangs mnyam gcig

/sems can gcig gi sems dang spyod pa shes// de lta'i tshul gyis sems can thams cad kyi// sems dang spyod (202)pa shes par bya dgos kyang*// mi zhum pa yi go cha'i snying stobs bskyed// dge ba chos sdud phyin drug lam la sbyor// sems can don byed ji ltar rigs pas so// 'gal rkyen le lo zhum nas mi 'jug pa// phyi bshol byed dang bya ba dman la chags// skye ba'i rgyu ni snyom las bde la zhen// gnyid la sred dang 'khor bar skyo shas med// dal rten rnyed dka' bsam nas long yod bkag /dam chos dga' ba spang nas rnam g.yeng dga'// mi nus snyam pa'i zhum rnams bsal bar bya// bdag gi byang chub thob byar sgyid lug na// sbrang bu sogs kyis byang chub thob gsungs na// bdag lta mi yi byang chub cis mi thob// rkang lag la sogs btang mi nus snyam na// lci yang ma dpyad bdag ni 'jigs par zad// snying rje chen po'i stobs rgyas gyur pa'i tshe// lus gtong ba la dka' ba yod ma yin// dang po tshod ma la sogs ster nas bslab// bsod nams lus bde mkhas pas sems bde na// 'khor bar gnas kyang snying rje can mi skyo// tshogs mtha' yas pa rdzogs mi nus snyam na// sems can don du sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod pas// dus ring tshogs mtha' yas pa bsgrub snyam pa'i// sdom pa bzung nas gnyid log ma log dang*// sems gzhan g.yeng dang ma g.yeng thams cad du// (203)bsod nams nam mkha' mnyam pa gsog pas na// tshogs mtha' yas pa rdzogs par dka' ba med// mthun rkyen dpung gi tshogs bsags pa la bzhi// mos brtan dga' dang dor ba'i stobs rnams las// brtson 'grus rten ni mos pa de'i rten ni// las 'bras yid ches pa yi dad pa yin// theg chen sgor zhugs rang gzhan nyes pa rnams// bsal zhing yon tan mtha' dag bsgrub rnams ni// re re bsgrub la bskal pa du mar yang*// goms pa dgos na cha shas re re yang*// bdag la med pas dal ba don med du// btang 'dug snyam du rang la rang gis bskul// brtan pa'i stobs ni gang la brtson 'grus brtsom// de las mi ldog mthar 'byin pa yin la// brtag nas zhugs kyi zhugs nas 'dor mi bya// 'dor ba goms nas skye ba gzhan du yang*// sdom pa khas blangs dam bca' brtan mi 'gyur// las kyi nga rgyal gzhan la mi ltos par// rang nyid gcig pus sgrub bo snyam pa'o// nyon mongs dbang du ma gyur don sgrub nus// nus pa'i nga rgyal nyon mongs 'di dag ni// bdag las nam yang rgyal bar mi bya'o// snyam pa'i blo ni nyon mongs nga rgyal nyid// ltung bas pham na rgyal 'dod bzhad gad gnas// dga' ba'i stobs ni dang por zhugs pa dang*// mi ngoms pa yin rtsed mor byis pa bzhin// 'bras bu mi ngoms bzhin du rgyu la yang*// mi ngoms pa dgos spu gri'i sbrang rtsi bzhin// las mtha' (204)phyin phyir nyi mas gdungs pa yis// glang chen mtshor 'phrad mtshor 'jug ji bzhin no// dor ba'i stobs ni lus sems dub pa na// re zhig ngal bso zin nas brtson 'grus brtsam// thang lhod med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bya// 'thab snying dgra dang ral kha lhags pa bzhin// tshur la gzur zhing phar la 'jebs par brtag

/dran pa'i mtshon shor 'jigs dran myur du blangs// nyes spyod chu yang de ma thag nas dgag /dran dang shes bzhin mi nyams rtag tu bsgrims// nyes pa byung na smad cing phyin chad sdom// spang blang dmigs byed thos pa byas nas kyang*// spyod lam kun tu dran pa rgyun chags brten// bslab pa'i tshul dang ma bslab nyes dmigs dang*// nyon mongs dgrar blta dka' spyad rgyan du blta// dge la bkol dus ldang ba yang bar bya// bsam gtan ngo bo dmigs pa las gzhan du// mi g.yeng gnas pa'i rtse gcig sems dge ba// ngo bos phye na 'das dang ma 'das gnyis// byed las lus sems shin sbyangs bde gnas byed// mngon shes la sogs yon tan mngon par bsgrub// sems can don byed pa yi bsam gtan no// shes rab ngo bo brtag pa'i dngos po la// chos rab rnam par 'byed par byed pa yin// 'dir ni rig pa'i gnas lngar mkhas pa'o// (205)'di dang phyi ma'i yon tan rtsa ba dang*// sbyin sogs lnga yi mig dang 'dra ba yin// theg pa gong 'og mdo sngags gnyis la sogs// gnang bkag mi 'dra mang du yod pa rnams// gang zag gcig gis nyams su len pa la// mi 'gal ba yang shes rab byed pa yin// bden gnyis rnam dag gsung rab phan tshun la// gnang bkag mang yang dgongs pa mi 'gal bar// shes rab 'byed pa 'di ni shes rab kyi// bsngags pa bla na med par gyur pa yin// mdor na yon tan thams cad shes rab las// 'byung zhing shes rab med na sbyin sogs la// mig dang bral zhing yang dag lta mi rnyed// shes rab bsgrub phyir thos pa brtsal bar bya// de las bsam dang sgom byung shes rab skye// dam pa rnams kyi zhal nas sngar thos pa'i// chos rnams blo la rug ge yod byas la// yang yang sems zhing 'jal la rtog par byed// dgos kyi sngar thos chos rnams brjed bcug nas// sems 'dzin rkyang pa re la slob pa der// grogs med sgom chen rab la ston pa rab// sgom chen 'bring la ston pa 'bring 'ong ngo*// ji tsam bsgom pa de tsam shes pa dgos// de ltar bsam pas nges shes brtan pa na// dge dang mi dge'i bsam pa thams cad ni// rtog pa yin pas spang bya yin zhes (206)par// sdig grogs pas zer chos nas de ma gsungs// dge ba'i bshes kyang de ltar mi bzhed pas/

kho yi kha la mi nyan pa zhig 'ong*// de med dad pa bag re yod pa de// ngu ba'i kha la bltas na ngu bro zhing*// rgod pa'i kha la bltas na rgod bro la// ci zer bden snyam gar khrid sar 'gro gsungs// dbye na bdag med don dam rtogs pa dang*// kun rdzob rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa dang*// sems can rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don bsgrub pa'o// gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi// sbyin pa sngar bshad snyan par smra ba ni// gdul bya rnams la phar phyin ston pa'o// don spyod ji ltar bstan pa'i don de rnams// gdul bya rnams la spyod 'jug don mthun no// gzhan la ston der rang yang mthun par slob// 'khor sdud la ni thog mar de dag dgos// zang zing sbyin pas lus la phan 'dogs pa// de nas snyan par smra bas chos bshad pas// phyin ci ma log don de 'dzin du 'jug /shes nas dge ba sgrub la 'jug par byed// rang gis ma bsgrubs sgrub tu mi nyan pas// rang gi sgrub na kho rang gnas par byed// byed las bzhi yang dga' dang the tshom gcod// sgrub dang zhugs la mi ldog yun ring bsgrub// gdul bya'i don grub thabs bzang por gsungs na/ (207)/'khor bsdud pa rnams 'di la brten dgos so// 'jig rten tshul dang ldan pa'i snyan smra ni/ khro gnyer med cing bzhin mdangs gsal ba yi// 'dzum pa sngon btang khams 'dri la sogs bya// yang dag chos bstan dang ldan snyan smra ni// phan bde'i phyir du gzhan la chos ston pa'o// gsod pa'i dgra la phan pa'i tshig brjod dang*// dbang po btul la skyo ba spang pa dang*// log sgrub can la zhe sdang med pa dang*// bde 'gro'i phyir du sbyin dang tshul khrims dang*// rgyud smin pa la yang dag phul gyi chos// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam bzhi ston pa dang*// bag med pa rnams bag yod bskul ba dang*// the tshom bsal phyir 'bel gtam byed rnams so// don spyod tshe 'di'i longs spyod chos mthun spel// phyi ma'i don du rab tu byung la 'god// 'das dang ma 'das chags bral 'dzin du 'jug

/dang po zang zing lhag ma chos kyi so// tshogs kyis lam la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis// mnyam rjes kun tu phar phyin las mi 'da'// de phyir byang sems sdom pa bzung snyam gyis// spyod pa rnams la mi slob pa'i thabs med// spyod pa slob pa'i spro shugs 'phel ba dang*// sdom pa bzung na shin tu brtan par 'gyur/ (208)

skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa'i skabs so/ khyad par phar phyin tha ma gnyis slob tshul// theg pa che chung yon tan 'jig rten dang*// 'jig rten 'das kun zhi lhag 'bras bu yin// ting 'dzin kun kyi spyi chings zhi lhag gnyis// zhi gnas ngo bo phung sogs dmigs yul la// sems gzhan mi g.yeng dran shes rgyun chags su// dmigs pa ngang gi gnas te lus dang sems// shin sbyangs dga' bde skyes de zhi gnas yin// lhag mthong ngo bo chos rab rnam par 'byed// ji lta ji snyed gnyis la gnyis kas dmigs// stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi gnas kyang yod la// stong nyid ma rtogs lhag mthong yang yod do// des na ji lta ba la dmigs pa yi// ting 'dzin shes rab yul bdag med pa la// blo des rtogs dang ma rtogs sgo nas phye// mtshan ma log ris blta phyir mar me ni// shin tu gsal dang rlung gi mi g.yo ba// gnyis dang ldan na gsal bar mthong ba bzhin// so sor rtogs pa rnam par dpyad pa des// lus sems shin sbyangs bskyed pa lhag mthong yin// zhi gnas thob kyang dpyad pas de mi thob// zhi gnas thob nas dpyad pas de mthong phyir// lhag mthong sngon du zhi gnas rgyur dgos so// de la dang po zhi gnas bslab tshul la// mthun pa'i yul ni zas gos (209)rnyed sla dang*// dgra sogs med dang nad mi skyed pa'i sa// tshul khrims lta ba mtshungs pa'i grogs dang ldan// nyin mo mi med mtshan mo sgra chung bas// legs par ldan pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan// 'dod pa chung ba lhag par chags pa med// ngan ngon rnyed pas rtag tu chog shes pa'o// gzhan dang ha cang 'dris shes byed pa dang*// nyo tshong sman dang skar rtsis la sogs spang*// so byang bslab pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag /chags sogs 'dod pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spang*// bde ba'i stan la skyil krung phyed pa'ang rung// mig ni sna rtser lus ni drang por bsrang*// lag pa mnyam bzhag mgo ni mi yo ba// so mchu tha mal lce ni ya so'i drung*// dbugs ni dal bus 'bad pa med par 'jug

/rmugs dang gnyid sogs mi 'byung dgos pa ldan// shin sbyangs thob na le lo mi 'byung la*// de'i rgyu brtson 'grus rgyun ldan brtsom dgos so// de la ting 'dzin don gnyer 'dun pa dgos// de'i rgyu yon tan mthong ba'i dad pa dgos// yon tan sems pa'i dad pa yang yang bsgoms// gang la dmigs na khyab pa'i dmigs pa dang*// spyad pa rnam par sbyong dang mkhas pa dang*// nyon mongs rnam par sbyong ba'i (210)dmigs pa'o/ khyab pa'i dmigs pa la yang rnam pa bzhi// dmigs byed sgo nas gzugs brnyan rnam pa gnyis// gzugs brnyan rnam pa blo la snang ba'o// lhag mthong dpyod byed rnam rtog yod pa dang*// zhi gnas rtog pa med pas mi rtog pa// dmigs pa gang gi gzugs brnyan yin snyam na// spyad pa rnam sbyong dmigs pa lnga dang ni// mkhas pa'i dmigs lnga nyon mongs rnam sbyong gnyis// dmigs bya yul la dngos po'i mtha' yin te// 'di tsam zad kyi 'di las gzhan med ces// ji snyed dngos po'i mtha' dang 'di kho nar// gnas kyi gzhan du mi gnas ji lta ba// ji snyed phung khams skye mched bden bzhi dang*// ji lta de nyid rigs pas grub pa'i don// 'bras bu'i sgo nas dgos pa yongs su grub// goms pas gnas ngan len dang bral ba'o// spyad pa rnam sbyong chags sogs sbyong ba la// mi sdug byams dang rten 'brel khams rab dbye// dbugs kyi 'byung rngub lnga ste mi sdug pa// skra sogs so drug nang gi mi sdug pa// rnam pa sngo sogs phyi yi mi sdug pa// byams pa phan bde bsgrub pa'i bsam pa'o// rten 'brel chos la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung*// de ma gtogs pa'i nyams su myong ba med/ khams kyi rab dbye sa sogs khams drug dbye// dbugs ni phyi nang 'byung rngub bgrang la blta// (211)mkhas pa'i dmigs pa phung khams skye mched dang*// rten 'brel gnas dang gnas min mkhas pa'o// phung lnga ma gtogs bdag dang bdag gi med/

khams rnams sa bon 'byung ba'i rgyu yin rkyen// skye mched bdag rkyen dmigs rkyen de ma thag /rten 'brel bcu gnyis mi rtag sdug bsngal dang*// bdag med par shes dge la bde 'byung gnas// mi dge bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas ma yin// nyon mongs rnam sbyong sa bon nyams smad tsam// zhi drag lam dang rtsad nas spang ba ni// bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug go /de dag rnam pa shar la sems 'dzin pa'o// dmigs pa 'di rnams zhi lhag gnyis ka yis// dmigs pa yin yang zhi gnas gsar du bsgrub/ khyad par can byed dmigs par 'gyur ba'o// de nas skabs su bab pa'i dmigs pa ni// nyon mongs gang che'i gnyen po bslab pa dang*/ khyad par de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la dmigs// yul gyi don spyi shar la dmigs pa yin// dmigs pa gcig la zhi gnas 'grub nas kyang*// de nas mang po la yang rim par bslab// bsgrub bya'i ting 'dzin gsal cha'i ngar dang ldan// rtse gcig gnas pa'i mi rtog gnas cha ldan// de la bying rgod gegs kyi (212)gtso bo yin// dmigs la mi g.yeng thabs ni dran pa dang*// g.yeng dang ma g.yeng brtag pa'i shes bzhin gces// des na sems ni dmigs rten bzhag pa dang*// gsar du mi rtog blo de'i shugs ma chad// rgyun skyong ba ni dran pa brten tshul yin// dper na ka bar glang po dam du btags// glang rdzis bslab ltar mi byed lcags kyu yis// gtsags nas khad kyi khad kyi dbang byed bzhin// dran pa'ang nges pa'i rnam pa'i 'dzin stangs can// nges shes 'dzin stangs dam pos ting 'dzin skyong*// thun tshad ji tsam nus pa de srid du/ khams kyi bar chad byung na bsal te bsgom// rgod pa chags pa'i sems kyis yul la g.yeng*// nyon mongs gzhan gyis g.yeng ba rnam g.yeng yin// dge la 'phro sogs thams cad rgod pa min// bying ba dmigs pa'i 'dzin stangs lhod nas ni// dwangs cha yod kyang shin tu gsal ba'am// dam pa mi 'dzin pa ni bying bar 'gro// bying la dge dang lung ma bstan gnyis yod// rmugs pa gti mug cha shas lus dang sems// lci zhing las su mi rung ba yin pas// mi dge ba dang bsgribs la lung ma bstan// bying ba sel la sangs rgyas sku gzugs sogs// dga' ba'i yul ni yid la bya ba dang*// snang ba bsgoms nas sems gzengs bstod dgos gsungs// de bas sems la mun (213)

pa bab pa lta'i// yul mi gsal dang 'dzin stangs 'phangs dma' ru// song rnams bkag nas dmigs pa gsal ba dang*// 'dzin stangs grim cha gnyis char yod dgos kyi// yul gsal tsam dang yul can dwangs cha tsam// yod pas mi chog legs par ngos zin gces// bsgom tshe bying rgod byung ngam ma byung dang*// byung dogs mthong na shes bzhin skye dgos so// shes bzhin ma skyes bsgom lo byas tshad kun// bying rgod phra mos dus 'da' ba yin no// de phyir dran pa brten bzhin 'phro mi 'phro'i// bya ra thun re byas nas sems 'dzin dgos// bying rgod skye brabs byed na shes bzhin bskyed// yengs nas 'gro ba'i brjed ngas dran pas gsos// bying rgod byung ma thag tu gnyen po bskyed// bying ba'i rgyu ni dbang po'i sgo ma bsrungs// zas tshod ma rig nam gyi stod smad nyal// shes bzhin med dang le lo sogs las skye// rgod pa'i rgyu ni chags sems skyo ba med// 'gog pa'i dus ni thog mar rgod pa dgag /gnas cha nam byung bying ba'i zon byas te// gsal ba'i ngar gdon re gnyis res mos bya// bying rgod bral tshe gnyen po'i rtsol ba spang*// tshor 'du tshad med gsum las 'du byed kyi// btang snyoms sgom pas zhi gnas (214)skyon med skye// ting nge 'dzin de nyes pa lnga spong nas// 'du byed brgyad ni brten pa'i rgyu las skye// ting nge 'dzin la mi sbyor le lo dang*// brtson tshe gdams pa'i dmigs pa brjed pa dang*// mnyam par bzhag la bying rgod byung ba dang*// de byung gnyen po mi rtsol bral ba'i tshe// gnyen po 'du byed sems pa nyes pa yin// le lo'i gnyen po dad 'dun rtsol shing sbyongs// gzhan bzhi'i gnyen por dran dang shes bzhin dang*// 'du byed sems pa rnal 'jog btang snyoms so// ting 'dzin las rung des ni rdzu 'phrul sogs// yon tan bsgrub pa'i gzhi 'gyur rkang pa 'dra// de 'grub pa la 'dun pa drag po dang*// brtson 'grus rgyun ring dmigs pa rnam par 'byed// sems rtse gcig pa thob la rkang pa bzhi// sems gnas skye ba'i rim pa rnam pa dgu// sems 'jog pa ni phyi rol dmigs pa las// sems bsdus nang du dmigs la gtod par byed// dang por gtad pa'i sems de gzhan du ni// mi g.yeng dmigs pa de la rgyun du 'jog

/phyi rol g.yeng na slar yang dmigs pa la// blan te 'jog dang dran pa'i stobs bskyed nas// phyi rol g.yeng bar mi byed nye bar 'jog /ting 'dzin yon tan bsam nas dga' ba ni// dul bar byed dang rnam g.yeng skyon du bltas// ting (215)nge 'dzin la mi dga' zhi bar byed// chags sems yid mi bde dang gnyid rmugs sogs// nye nyon byung na nye bar zhi bar byed// 'bad med 'jug phyir 'bad pa byed pa ni// rtse gcig byed dang sems mnyam gyur pa la// btang snyoms byed pa mnyam par 'jog pa yin// de yang stobs drug gis 'grub thos stobs kyis// dang po bsam pa'i stobs kyis gnyis pa dang*// dran pa'i stobs kyis blan dang nye bar 'jog /shes bzhin stobs kyis dul dang zhi bar byed// brtson 'grus stobs kyis rnam par rtse gcig byed// 'dris pa'i stobs kyis mnyam par 'jog sems 'grub// goms pa che bas 'bad med ngang gis 'jug /phyi ma de rnams snga ma rnams las skye// dang po gnyis la bsgrim te 'jug pa dang*// sems lnga'i bying rgod bar chad 'jug pa dang*// brgyad pa la ni 'chad pa med par 'jug /dgu par rtsol med 'jug pa'i yid byed bzhi// 'bad med 'jug kyang shin sbyangs ma thob na// zhi gnas rjes mthun yin gyi zhi gnas min// spyod lam kun dang 'dres thub ltar snang ba'i// ting nge 'dzin ni 'dod sems rtse gcig yin// shin sbyangs thob lugs ci 'dra yin zhe na// lus saims gnas ngan len dang bral (216)bas na// dge ba'i bya bar bkol la las su rung*// de yang nyon mongs spong bar dga' ba la// bar du gcod cing nyon mongs phyogs gyur pa'i// lus kyi gnas ngan len ni nyon mongs pa// spong la rtsol tshe lus lci la sogs pa'i// las su mi rung ba dang bral nas lus// ldang ba yang ba las su rung ba'o// de bzhin sems ni dmigs par thogs med du// 'jug pa sems ni las su rung ba'o// mdor na shin sbyangs thob na nyon mongs pa// spong la rtsol bar 'dod kyang 'tsher snang gis// 'jug dka'i lus sems las su mi rung ba// log nas lus sems shin tu bkol bde ba// ldan par 'gyur ba phra nas je cher 'ong*// shin sbyangs skye ba'i snga ltas gang zag de'i// klad pa lci sems pa snyam byed pa skye// mi bde ba yi lci ba ma yin no// de skyes ma thag nyon mongs spong ba la// dga' ba'i bar chad byed pa'i gnas ngan len// bral bar 'gyur zhing de yi gnyen po ni// sems kyi shin tu sbyangs pa sngon la skye// de yi mthu las lus ni shin tu sbyangs// skye ba'i rgyu gyur rlung ni lus la rgyu// rlung de lus kyi cha snyom khyab pa na// lus kyi gnas ngan len dang bral bar 'gyur// de yi gnyen po lus shin sbyangs pa skye//

(217)de yang lus kun rgyas nas las rung ba'i// rlung gis gang ba bzhin du snang bar 'gyur// de ni lus kyi nang gi reg bya chos// yid du 'ong ba yin gyi sems byung min// thog mar skyes tshe rlung mthus bde ba'i nyams// lus bzhin sems la'ang dga' bde'i nyams 'byung ngo*// de rjes shugs der rim gyi chung ngur 'gro// ting nge 'dzin dang mthun par 'byung ba yin// de nas dmigs la brten par gnas pa yi// dga' ba chen pos bskyod pa'i zhi gnas thob// bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs kyis bsdus pa'i// zhi gnas thob pas mnyam par bzhag pa yi// yid byed chung shos thob pa'i rtags mtshan ni// lam des nyon mongs rnam sbyong nus dang ldan// mnyam par bzhag na myur bar shin sbyangs skye// 'dod pa 'dun sogs sgrib pa lnga phal cher// mi 'byung mnyam par bzhag las langs pa'i tshe'ang*// lus sems shin sbyangs 'ga' re ldan pa yin// yid byed des ni zhi gnas dag par 'gyur// zhi gnas des ni lus sems shin sbyangs 'dren// phan tshun gcig gi gcig spel byed pa'i phyir// 'di 'dra'i ting 'dzin rgyud la bskyed pa ni// nyon mongs 'joms pa'i lhag mthong bskyed (218)pa'i phyir// yin pas de la brten nas lhag mthong ni// ma bskyed de la ji tsam goms pas kyang*// 'dod khams nyon mongs spong bar mi nus na// nyon mongs thams cad spong ba lta ci smros// de phyir lhag mthong bsgom par bya dgos so// nyon mongs mngon gyur spong ba'i 'jig rten dang*// rtsad nas spong ba'i 'das lam lhag mthong gnyis// snga ma 'og mar rags dang gong mar zhi// zhi rags rnam par blta ba'i lhag mthong sgoms// 'dod yon lnga la 'dun zhing chags pa yi// gnyen po 'dod chags nyes dmigs dpyad nas bsgoms// 'dod pa'i skyon dang dang po'i yon tan la// mtshan nyid so sor rig pa zhes bya ba// re 'ga' thos dang res 'ga' bsam byung yin// thos bsam las 'das bsgom pas mtha' gcig tu// zhi rags don la mos par byed pa ni// mos las byung ba'i yid byed zhes bya'o// spyod pa lhag mthong 'jog pa zhi gnas bsgoms// dang po gnyis ni sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po// zhi lhag re mos goms pa la brten nas// 'dod nyon chen po'i gnyen po skyes pa na// rab tu dben pa'i yid byed ces bya'o// spel mar bsgoms pas nyon mongs 'bring spong bar//

(219)nus pa dga' ba bsdud pa'i yid byed do// 'dod nyon ting 'dzin gnas dang ldang ba'i skabs// mi rgyur mthong nas rtog pa rtsing mi byed// spyod pa chags dang bral lam ma bral snyam// sad phyir chags yul dmigs pas skyed mthong nas// de spong phyir bsgom dpyod pa'i rig byed do// dpyad dang 'jog pas 'dod nyon chung ngu yi// gnyen por skyes pa sbyor ba mthar thug pa// yid byed gsum bzhi drug ni spong gnyen yin// de ltar nyon mongs chung ngu spangs pa na// 'dod nyon mngon gyur bcom nas re zhig la// mi rgyu bar byed sa bon gtan bcom min// tshul 'dis ci yang med pa man chad la// chags pa bral bar byed la srid rtse yi// nyon mongs mngon gyur 'gog par mi nus pas// 'khor ba las ni brgal bar mi nus so// 'on kyang mngon shes sogs ni 'thob par byed// rgyas par nyan sar bzhugs pas der blta'o// de dag phyi rol pa dang thun mong yin// de 'dra'i ting 'dzin khyad par can thob kyang*// de tsam gyis ni srid las mi grol bar// ma zad 'khor bar 'ching bas zhi gnas kyi// chog shes mi bya bdag med lta ba btsal// gsung rab (220)dgongs 'brel kun la ma rmongs pa'i// blo gros rnam dpyod phul du byung ba yi// grags pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum mdzes pa// tsong kha pa yis skye kun rjes 'dzin shog
zhi gnas kyi skabs so// 'di 'og lhag mthong yod/ zhus so/// /
